units.source_text: 且说正在这一天，紫儿的父亲兵部卿亲王来探望她了。

en.t: Now, on that very day, Zier's father, Prince Hyobukyo, came to visit her.

units.source_text: 这邸宅比往年更加荒芜，广厦深宫，年久失修，屋多人少，阴气逼人。

en.t: The mansion had grown even more desolate than in previous years; its broad halls and deep chambers had long gone unrepaired, with many rooms and few people, and a chill, oppressive gloom filled the place.

units.source_text: 父亲环顾四周，慨然地说：“这种地方，小孩一刻也不能留的。

en.t: Her father looked all around and said with a sigh, "A child cannot be left in a place like this for even a moment.

units.source_text: 还是到我那边去吧。

en.t: You had better come to my place instead.

units.source_text: 那边万事都很方便：乳母有专用的房间，可以安心服侍；

en.t: Everything there is convenient: the nurse will have her own room and can attend to you without worry;

units.source_text: 姑娘有许多孩子作伴，不致寂寞。

en.t: the young lady will have many children for company and will not be lonely.

units.source_text: 一切都很舒服。”

en.t: Everything will be comfortable."

units.source_text: 他唤紫儿到身边来。

en.t: He called Zier over to his side.

units.source_text: 源氏公子身上的衣香沾染在紫儿身上，气味非常馥郁。

en.t: The fragrance from Prince Genji's robes had clung to Zier, and the scent was richly sweet.

units.source_text: 父亲闻到了这香气，说道：“好香啊！

en.t: Her father noticed the fragrance and said, "What a lovely scent!

units.source_text: 可惜这衣服太旧了。”

en.t: It is a pity these clothes are so old."

units.source_text: 他觉得这女孩很可怜。

en.t: He felt deeply sorry for the girl.

units.source_text: 接着又说：“她好几年和患病的老太太住在一起。

en.t: Then he went on, "For several years she lived together with the ailing old lady.

units.source_text: 我常常劝老太太将她送到我那边去，也好和那边的人熟悉些。

en.t: I often urged the old lady to send her to my place, so that she might become familiar with the people there.

units.source_text: 可是老太太异常嫌恶我家，始终拒绝。

en.t: But the old lady had an extraordinary dislike for my household and refused to the very end.

units.source_text: 于是我家那个人心中也不快了。

en.t: As a result, that person in my household also became displeased.

units.source_text: 到这时候才送去，其实反而不体面呢。”

en.t: To send her there only now would, in fact, be rather improper."

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母说：“请大人放心。

en.t: Shonagon, her nurse, said, "Please set your mind at ease, my lord.

units.source_text: 目前虽然寂寞，也是暂时之事，不须挂念。

en.t: Although things are lonely for the moment, it is only temporary, and there is no need to worry.

units.source_text: 且待姑娘年事稍长，略解人情世故，再迁居府上，较为妥善。”

en.t: It would be more suitable to wait until the young lady is a little older and understands something of the ways of the world before moving her to your residence."

units.source_text: 又叹一口气说：“姑娘日夜想念老太太，饮食也少进了。”

en.t: Then she sighed and said, "The young lady thinks of the old lady day and night, and she has been eating very little."

units.source_text: 紫儿的确瘦损了不少，然而相貌反而清秀艳丽了。

en.t: Zier had indeed grown much thinner, yet her appearance had become even more pure and lovely.

units.source_text: 兵部卿对她说：“你何必如此想念外祖母？

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo said to her, "Why must you miss your grandmother so much?

units.source_text: 现在她已经不是这世间的人了，悲伤有什么用处呢？

en.t: She is no longer a person of this world now, so what use is there in grieving?

units.source_text: 有我在这里，你可放心。”

en.t: I am here, so you may be at ease."

units.source_text: 天色渐暮，兵部卿准备回去了。

en.t: As the sky gradually darkened, Prince Hyobukyo prepared to return home.

units.source_text: 紫儿啼啼哭哭，依依不舍。

en.t: Zier sobbed and wept, reluctant to let him go.

units.source_text: 做父亲的也不免流下同情之泪，再三地安慰她：“千万不要这么想不开！

en.t: As her father, he too could not help shedding tears of pity, and comforted her again and again: "You must not take things so hard!

units.source_text: 我不久就来迎接你！”

en.t: I will come to bring you home before long!"

units.source_text: 然后回去。

en.t: Then he went back.
